text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер wins the Arima Kinen and
attributes
her success in the tough race
to the support of
her fans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She then tries to ask Мэдзиро МакКуин
and Mejiro
Ryan the secret to becoming
even stronger than
she is now.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The two promise to answer this question
properly
at a later time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Showing signs of new growth, Nice
Nature aims
for her next goal—the
Takarazuka Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
